'''Video scanners''' were in-expensive, two-dimensional [[Security scanner/Legends|security scanners]]. They were in use virtually everywhere, from private residences to retail stores. Video scanners recorded sound and images, storing them on [[Datacard/Legends|datadisks]] and [[Data-tape/Legends|datatapes]].<ref name="EGWT" />
